name: Alexandra Ion
title: Assistant Professor; Interim Associate Director of HCI Undergraduate Programs
department: Human-Computer Interaction Institute; courtesy Robotics Institute and Mechanical Engineering
fitReason: A strong physically grounded human-AI interaction option for a CS researcher interested in multimodal perception, intent reasoning and assistive action generation. The lab combines software with building physical interfaces; a purely software-only project is not guaranteed.

physicalEvidence.summary: Object Agents (UIST 2025) links GPT-4o/mini scene and intent reasoning with fine-tuned YOLOv11-OBB perception and actual two-wheeled, Bluetooth-controlled everyday objects. A ceiling camera and external computer provide sensing, hybrid A* planning and PD control; onboard Arduino devices execute motor commands. The prototype’s perception/reasoning loop runs continuously, with reported 5–10-second end-to-end latency. Physical application demonstrations are separate from the user study, which rates recommendations generated from recorded videos. The first author, Violet Han, is a currently listed Ion advisee. The 2026 architectural-interaction study is Wizard-of-Oz and is not evidence of new autonomous AI control.

shortVisit.summary: The live lab Work with us page explicitly accepts internship applications by email with CV, work samples, transcript, preferred start and duration, and two recommendation contacts. This internship section is separate from the CMU-only undergraduate/master’s independent-study section. No eight-week minimum, external degree-stage rule, 2027 availability, stipend or personal-funding arrangement is specified.

scoreReasons.fit: 37/40: close multimodal reasoning, physical assistance and HRI match; interface-building emphasis differs from general manipulation learning.
scoreReasons.physical: 25/25: own-current-advisee full primary prototype continuously links AI outputs to actual robotic-object actuation.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: 8/20: explicit current internship inquiry with proposed duration, but no confirmed external-master’s eight-week/2027 placement.
scoreReasons.freshness: A distinct dated 2026 architectural-interaction study establishes current research activity; its Wizard-of-Oz design does not change the separately dated 2025 autonomous-prototype evidence.
